market_summary: Late New York session trading exhibits widespread consolidation and low RVOL across all watched assets. Metals, FX, and BTCUSD remain structurally suppressed below their respective session VWAP and Value Area Low levels, hovering in tight bands above Session Low supports without breakout volume. US100 has pulled back sharply from its Session High into Put Wall #1 and Gamma Flip support in a Positive Dampening GEX regime, precluding fresh shorts while awaiting a confirmed reversal. All assets present low-edge conditions, warranting a disciplined HOLD across the board.
